contentPattern: Collection of cards, one row per card with an image cell and a text cell. Default: plain responsive grid of image-over-text cards. Article List option (the catalog look on the blog listing): 4-across grid (1/2/3 columns on smaller screens) of article cards, each with a photo, a date line, a 2-line clamped bold title (optionally linked, making the whole card clickable) and a 3-line clamped excerpt; only the first 8 cards show until a centered outlined "Show All" button reveals the rest (an optional trailing link-only row sets the button label).
